bio: With delicious food, friendly service, a welcoming and charming vibe, this restaurant in a residential area just outside the city centre is a magnet for diners. The contemporary cuisine makes use of predominantly regional produce. The meticulously prepared and beautifully plated dishes are served in the format of a four- or five-course set menu, with vegetarian alternatives for the meat/fish courses – and it is possible to opt for the "upgrade", an additional course. Wine or alcoholic drinks pairings are available. The space is sleek and modern yet cosy, and tables are set up on a terrace on the pavement outside.
